Theorem
[Reduced distance based at the singular time for a sequence of solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0162, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0163, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0164, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0165 ↗ def:chow-iv-reduced-distance-singular-time ↗ cor:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-compact-bound ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-gradient-bound ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-time-bound 1. ch30:30.10\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

Suppose complete bounded-curvature pointed Ricci flows $(\mathcal M_i,g_i(t),p_i)$, $t\in [\alpha _i,\omega _i]$, converge smoothly in pointed Cheeger--Gromov sense to $(\mathcal M_\infty ,g_\infty (t),p_\infty )$, with $\omega _i earrow \omega _\infty $, and satisfy the uniform Type A estimate. Then a subsequence of $\widetilde\ell _i$ converges in $C^ eta _{\mathrm{loc}}$, for every $ eta \in (0,1)$, to a locally Lipschitz reduced distance $\ell _\infty $. In both the support and weak senses, \[ -\partial _t\ell _\infty -\Delta _{g_\infty }\ell _\infty +| abla \ell _\infty |^2-R_{g_\infty } + rac{n}{2(\omega _\infty -t)}\geq 0. \]
